description: Deltas at Risk is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Development Mekong. The Delta at Risk study is a global, systematic assessment of how delta risk is increasing due to sea-level rise and human drivers of delta land subsidence. Risk is expected to increase greatly due to relative sea-level rise in deltas. Coverage: the Mekong region (Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar, Thailand, Vietnam). The portal files it under the publisher Open Development Mekong. Its tags are Climate change, Community fisheries, Floods, Rivers and lakes. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2016-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is unspecified. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
